mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has declined from -44.9% to -47.4% over the past four weeks, signaling sustained workplace closure or remote work. This persistent suppression of commuting activity directly reduces weekday retail foot traffic, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean over the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES recovers by more than 10 percentage points in any single week.

candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 20 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite PARKS remaining below 25%, or PARKS rebounds above 40% without a corresponding RETAIL_REC rise.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below -50% over the next 28 days despite PARKS falling below 30%, or PARKS rebounds above 40% without RETAIL_REC recovery.
